body: Founder decision (asked directly): build allies/multi-hero-per-team in arena, over territory or declaring the 4-hero roster complete. Team-mode infra already existed from the 10v10 pivot -- the real gap was just an ally-targeting primitive. Added arena_nearest_ally (mirrors arena_nearest_enemy), threaded an ally param through tick_hero_kit. Unblocked: Ghost's Recital ally-heal side, Frog's Borrowed Time (generic next_cast_refund buff mechanism, reusable by any future ally-buff kit), and Doc Wheel (Buer) as a full new fifth hero -- HP%-scaled heal+cleanse, teleport-to-ally, teamwide cleanse+heal (simplified from a literal shield, flagged not faked). Found and fixed a real test bug: a Unicorn with no move target/foe never reaches its cooldown-setting code, so an assertion had been passing by coincidence not correctness. apps/arena_bot draft picker and apps/arena_server pick-validation bound updated for wire-level draftability. 16 new headless tests, full suite green. Verified live: two real bot matches (10-bot, 20-bot) both drafted Doc Wheel without incident. Commit df58b13.
title: Allies + Doc Wheel, first ally-only hero (S170-34)
